description.value: Travelodge by Wyndham Langley is a two-storey budget hotel situated on Fraser Highway in Langley, BC, part of the nationally recognized Travelodge chain. It sits along a major highway corridor in the Fraser Valley, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling between the Lower Mainland and the Interior. As a branded chain property it offers a standardized lodging experience with predictable amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at travelodgelangleycity.com resolved but redirected to the generic Wyndham/Travelodge central booking platform, yielding no property-specific amenity details; consequently, most amenity fields cannot be confirmed from website content. OSM tags supply free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no), which is the only amenity tag present and treated as supplementary evidence since the website does not confirm or contradict it. No evidence in OSM or the fetched website addresses bike storage, staff procedures, laundry, breakfast, or any other cycling-specific amenity.
concerns: Website URL resolves to the generic Wyndham central booking platform rather than a dedicated property page, so no property-specific amenity details could be extracted from the fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain hotel on a major cycling route in the Fraser Valley; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists as an overnight stop.
